name: fruit-blade-frenzy
description: A polished HTML5 fruit-slicing arcade mini-game built with Canvas2D, CSS3, and Web Audio API.

scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'), fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); const mime={'.html':'text/html','.css':'text/css','.js':'application/javascript','.json':'application/json'}; http.createServer((req,res)=>{ let f = path.join(__dirname, req.url === '/' ? 'index.html' : req.url); if(fs.existsSync(f) && !fs.statSync(f).isDirectory()){ res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': mime[path.extname(f)] || 'text/plain'}); fs.createReadStream(f).pipe(res); } else { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not Found'); } }).listen(3000, ()=>console.log('Serving on http://localhost:3000'));"

author: Fruit Blade Frenzy Dev
